items.title: Nuvama initiates coverage on KPR Mill and 2 other textile stocks, sees up to 35% upside. Here's why
items.description: Nuvama Institutional Equities has initiated coverage on KPR Mill, Indo Count Industries and Sanathan Textiles with 'Buy' ratings, citing the global shift in textile sourcing away from China. The brokerage expects Indian textile exporters to benefit from supply chain realignment, supported by capacity expansion, policy tailwinds and improving trade access.

items.title: Q1 earnings this week: Infosys, Eternal, Bajaj Auto among 573 companies set to announce June quarter results
items.description: This week, 573 companies will announce their June quarter results, featuring prominent firms.  Bharti Airtel and Nykaa are among those reporting earnings on Tuesday.  Trent and Hero MotoCorp will release their quarterly figures on Thursday.  State Bank of India and Titan Company are scheduled for Friday announcements.  The earnings cycle concludes Saturday with Anant Raj's results.

items.title: Will Nifty, Sensex extend gains on Monday? 6 factors which will drive D-Street action this week
items.description: Indian stock market is expected to extend recent gains this week.  The Reserve Bank of India's policy decision will significantly influence market direction.  Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and fluctuating oil prices remain key concerns.  Foreign institutional investors are showing renewed interest in Indian equities.  Corporate earnings announcements will also provide crucial trading cues for investors.
